name: cli-approved-dispatch
goal: Expose the approval-scoped worker batch through the plan start CLI without broadening execution permissions.

evidence: The service already verifies exact approval and bounds a worker batch; the CLI must expose it explicitly while preserving queue-only start and fail-closed provider qualification.
The existing FeaturePlanCommand registration case checked queue submission and retry only; it never exercised the approval-scoped worker service or invalid concurrency flags.
